title: cin-hollywood-2001-heavyweight-title
label: Mac Rollins

won.source: the promotion's own Sneak Preview of 4 July 2001, reporting Summer Blockbuster 01' (30 June 2001)

how: Won the ladder-match final of a sixteen-man, one-night tournament over The Boy Hedges to become the first champion.
note: The card itself was published on the promotion's website and is not held; the result is the promotion's own report of it. Still champion when the held record ends (14 July 2001).
